description: Virtual portfolio performance from newly delivered signals. This dashboard never represents broker positions or real orders.

panels.description: Initial virtual cash plus realized net PnL. Open positions are not marked to market.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (portfolio.initial_cash + COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0))::double precision AS "Realized Equity" FROM paper_portfolios portfolio LEFT JOIN paper_portfolio_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name WHERE portfolio.name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} GROUP BY portfolio.initial_cash;

panels.title: Realized Equity

panels.description: Net result from closed virtual positions after configured commission and slippage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(net_pnl), 0)::double precision AS "Realized PnL" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed';

panels.title: Realized PnL

panels.description: Number of currently open virtual positions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Open Positions" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'open';

panels.title: Open Positions

panels.description: Number of virtual positions with a resolved signal outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Closed Positions" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed';

panels.title: Closed Positions

panels.description: Share of closed virtual positions with positive net PnL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Win Rate" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed';

panels.title: Win Rate

panels.description: Average return after commission and slippage across closed positions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(net_return_pct)::double precision AS "Avg Net Return" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed';

panels.title: Avg Net Return

panels.description: Current virtual exposure. Entry values come from delivered signals, not broker orders.

targets.rawSql: SELECT position.entry_time, position.ticker, upper(position.direction) AS direction, position.entry_price, position.notional, prediction.source_channel, prediction.confidence FROM paper_portfolio_positions position JOIN signal_predictions prediction ON prediction.id = position.prediction_id WHERE position.portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND position.status = 'open' ORDER BY position.entry_time DESC;

panels.title: Open Virtual Positions

panels.description: Most recently closed virtual positions with costs and net outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT position.exit_time, position.ticker, upper(position.direction) AS direction, position.entry_price, position.exit_price, position.notional, position.net_return_pct, position.costs, position.net_pnl, prediction.source_channel FROM paper_portfolio_positions position JOIN signal_predictions prediction ON prediction.id = position.prediction_id WHERE position.portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND position.status = 'closed' ORDER BY position.exit_time DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Recent Closed Positions

panels.description: Running sum of net PnL from closed positions in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT exit_time AS time, sum(net_pnl) OVER (ORDER BY exit_time, id)::double precision AS "Cumulative Net PnL" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) ORDER BY exit_time;

panels.title: Cumulative Net PnL

panels.description: Net PnL grouped by close date. Costs are already included.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(exit_time, '1d'), sum(net_pnl)::double precision AS "Daily Net PnL" FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Daily Net PnL

panels.description: Closed-position performance grouped by ticker. Use larger samples before changing strategy thresholds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ticker, count(*) AS closed_positions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM paper_portfolio_positions WHERE portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND status = 'closed' GROUP BY ticker ORDER BY net_pnl DESC;

panels.title: Performance by Ticker

panels.description: Closed-position performance attributed to the primary Telegram channel stored on each signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(prediction.source_channel, 'unattributed') AS source_channel, count(*) AS closed_positions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE position.net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(position.net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(position.net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM paper_portfolio_positions position JOIN signal_predictions prediction ON prediction.id = position.prediction_id WHERE position.portfolio_name = ${portfolio:sqlstring} AND position.status = 'closed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_pnl DESC;

panels.title: Performance by Telegram Source
